title: Cheeni Kum
desc: A hard-edged London chef believes he's found true love, only to learn that his potential partner's father is surprisingly younger than him, complicating their romance

title: Nanu Ki Jaanu
desc: Nanu, A Land Mafia Agent, Tries To Rescue A Woman Who Met With An Accident. The Woman, However, Dies But Her Ghost Arrives In Nanu'S Apartment.

title: Jayantabhai Ki Luv Story
desc: When Simran, A Young Woman, Struggles To Settle In Mumbai And Lands Into A Hostile Neighbourhood, Jayantabhai, A Small-Time Gangster, Helps And Falls In Love With Her, Unaware That She Is His Rival.

title: Mohalla Assi
desc: The honest priest Pandeyji, finds that the locals of Banaras manipulate foreign tourists with fake spiritual gurus. He decides to intervene in the matter to set it right.

title: Makkhi
desc: Nani Loves Bindu But Is Killed By A Jealous Sudeep, Who Lusts After Bindu. Nani Is Reincarnated As A Fly And Decides To Avenge His Death. He Teams Up With Bindu To Make Sudeep'S Life A Living Hell.

title: Pippa
desc: In the 1971 Indo-Pakistani war, witness Balram Singh Mehta's valor as he fights bravely on the eastern front with the 45th Cavalry. Watch his heroic story unfold now!

title: Doctor G
desc: Uday Gupta, a medical student, the only male in the gynaecology department of a medical college, ends up in a series of hilarious situations due to his hesitance.

title: Murder Mubarak
desc: A maverick cop dives into a murder case, spotlighting a web of suspects. As he infiltrates their world, hidden truths unravel-revealing a mystery far deeper than expected.

title: Mili
desc: Mili, a nursing graduate, wishes to relocate to Canada. However, unfathomable circumstances come to the fore as she inadvertently gets trapped in a freezer.

title: U-Turn
desc: Mysterious deaths occur on a flyover after illegal U-turns, and journalist-intern Radhika investigates. However, a twist makes her the prime suspect, forcing her to clear her name.

title: Rang Rasiya
desc: A young and talented Raja Ravi Varma trains under the king of Kerala. He moves to British-era Bombay and meets Sugandha, who initially discredits his artwork but later becomes his muse.

desc: After the 2002 Gujarat riots, survivors, perpetrators, and silent witnesses face lasting scars, forcing them to confront the way tragedy reshapes lives, hearts, and entire communities forever.
